detail.longDescription: Yesterday the # OpenSSL project, acting as its own # CVE numbering authority, published CVE-2026-121481. CISA’s ADP enrichment attached a # CVSS 3.1 base score of 9.8 (Critical), and # GitHub advisory GHSA-83XJ-7XH4-4P7X mirrored the score. The headline number travelled fast. The mechanics travelled slower, which is a pity, because they are the better story. The bug is a piece of signed-integer arithmetic that has sat in a public # API since the SSLeay era, and the fix that won approval is an assertion instead of a new error code. # infosec https:// thecybersecguru.com/exploits/c ve-2026-121481-openssl-evp-encodeblock-overflow/
